name: Notebook Portfolio
pitch: Build a journal on facing pages: photos, tape, tickets and stickers, placed exactly where you want them.
problem: Templates decide your layout. A real notebook doesn't.

stats.label: stickers, from landmarks to wax seals
type kits that restyle every page at once
file to share: it opens and prints on its own

features.title: Put anything anywhere
features.text: Nothing snaps into slots. Every piece drags, resizes, rotates, layers and locks.
details: Tickets, tags, stamps, envelopes, postcards, washi tape
Pull washi tape longer and you get more pattern, not a stretch
A stencil layer you can save and reuse on any page

screen.alt: A kraft-paper page with a postage stamp, a tag, a receipt envelope, a postcard and stickers of a torii gate, a ramen bowl and a compass

features.title: A real open book
features.text: Pages face each other across a gutter, with a stitched, spiral or taped spine.
details: Drag a piece across the gutter and it moves to the other page
Covers in cloth, leather, kraft, marbled paper or linen
8 papers, from graph and dot to aged, set page by page

screen.alt: A two-page field notes spread: graph paper with an hour column, habit grid and checklist on the left, dot paper with a drawing area and photo frame on the right

features.title: Photos as material
features.text: Crop by dragging inside the frame, then cut, border, treat and draw on it.
details: Black and white, bleached or night treatments

features.title: Read, print or send it
features.text: Turn pages in 3-D, print at true size, or export one file that reads on its own.
details: + Today stamps out a dated page in your own layout
Kept in your browser, photos included
